notes.title: Update v1.1.2: Bug Fixes!
notes.content: Fixed the reeling and the letting go mechanic. No longer reels up the fish despite letting go.

notes.title: Update v1.1.1: New Music!!
notes.content: New music has been added for those who want some change in their fishing game! Music can changed in the options, and points/achievements are no longer granted when releasing a fish. Enjoy the sound of the new music!

notes.title: Update v1.1: Achievements!
notes.content: Achievements! You can now fish and enjoy getting as many achievements as you can! A few bug fixes such as fixing the size of the sea. More balancing and change of prices. Have fun collecting achievements, after all, you deserve a gold medal.

notes.title: Update: v.1.02
notes.content: Balancing fish prices and depths. A few bug fixes on the title screen. Due to excessive fishing, the fish have migrated upwards... a little too far...

notes.title: Ver. 1.01 Updated menu issues and balancing
notes.content: Fixed a few minor menu problems and balancing fish
